notes.title: Guadalindie 2025 feedback Patch!
notes.notes:
Last may we had the pleasure to have you playing the game in Guadalindie with the just released Chapter 4 update.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/bcbdbcca71c554a4adcba09011f6b39e5d56e145.jpg"]

We are very thankfull for your good feedback on the event and the help to identify which areas we have to improve Chapter 3 and 4.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/936da4ce2d6e2e78fe767cb68f2eeb0ec5bb22d7.gif"]

Down below you have the improvements of the update:



Inventory visualization improvement.

Repositioned Chapter 3 batteries, added some sound to detect them easier as well.

Jump mechanic, giving some sound feedback when landing and added a 10% plus to jump for gameplay.

Improved visual guidances in Chapter 3 for the prototype.

Now you can see SilverBall's path at some distance when its sticked to a green panel.

C.A.D.I. will detect your failure in earlier laboratory rooms and will advise you for your own good.

SilverBall dissapear animation improved.

Remapped skip dialogue key to allow you perform some hops while you are talking on a SilverPhone.

notes.title: Community feedback changes patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/ad2215a8a7fad3f63281633007492e5f79230336.jpg

After our assistance to Seville Mangafest 2023 some of you had the chance to test the game and give your feedback about Chapter 1&2 of the story mode. We want to appreciate your commitment to the game and we have been working on some adjustments to the game based on your feedback.

The list of changes is the following:


 Mass changes in lot of objects, light and medium objets will not fall if they are close to the player
 Objects are now grabbed closer to the camera.
 Glasses on the recycle game are now red. Napkins are now a bit bigger.
 Adding 20 more seconds to the hard mode of chapter 1.
 Added responsiveness to the crosshair.
 Interaction distance with objects have been reduced drastically now it is not possible to interact with doors far away.
 Fixed a bug that was preventing to hide the tutorials.
 Improved spacebar icon.
 Roquefort now look at the object after arriving to the posible destination.
 Crouch and quest tutorial have been improved.
 Motorbyke keys animation fixed.

notes.title: French translation added along with some bugfixes
notes.notes: French translation has been added for chapters 1 & 2 of the story mode along with some bugfixes related with the inventory, the UI and the management of the menus in the game.

notes.title: We got a date! December 8th we will release Chapters 1&2 of the story mode
notes.notes:
Hello again players!

We have been working really hard at Gadir Team "facilities" to bring you the next December 8th the Chapters 1&2 of the story mode.

And that's not all, here you have the new trailer with the adventures that await you in your new job at the SilverCup offices.

Are you ready?

[previewyoutube=P7Ca1oaT6IM;full][/previewyoutube]

See you next December 8th. Don't forget to send your feedback in our social networks.

notes.title: Arcade mode's finished! (patch v0.42)
notes.notes:
A little more than a year ago, we launched the Early Access for Lost and Found - What if I come and find it, and today we want to celebrate it with a patch which includes everything we had planned when we desgined the arcade mode. We are still open to suggestions from the community to include to the arcade mode. We believe in the potential of this mode if the community wants such thing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/044fd3a85b593b7833e8eb7df9ff03b59c167f77.gif

We are proud of the current state of the arcade mode because it lays the foundations for the playable mechanics of the story mode. It's full of new features, detailed below:


 New pack, "Even more lost", with 12 new lost objects.
 Third helper: the cart, a tool which will allow you to carry several items at the same time. Be careful not to load it too much.
 Added new achievements.
 In game user interface fully redesigned and improved.
 Added an accessibility option which allows to change the subtitles size.
 Redecorated break room.
 Enlarged hall plus hall of fame makeover.
 Mechanics improvements and bug fixing.


We hope you like the new content, and we want to tell you that we have started with enthusiasm the development of the story mode. We will keep you updated about it via Twitter, Discord and Steam.

In 2023, we hope to bring you more news and the first chapter of the story mode.
Thank you so much for everything!

notes.title: The summer update is here!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/f2f236b1addc84930f2a39d4d804d5b5a2402f84.png

It was about time for a new update! We hope this new content will make your summer afternoons easier. Here you got a list with the new features:


 New movie themed lost objects pack.
 New intelligent helper available in three different levels: Hamilton
 Power ups: try to beat your best scores  using the coffee of your preference/of your choice.
 New achievements based on the new content.
 New lost objects for the base pack.
 New skybox with dynamic clouds and stars in the night sky.
 Visual improvements and animations.
 Bug fixes and code improvements.


We hope you enjoy it and remember that in a few months the last arcade update will be released with new story mode info. Down below you have some singleplayer screens:

notes.title: Summer update is smooth sailing!
notes.notes:
Hi again, players!

We hope that you are having a great start of summer and that you're thrilling to know more about the next update for Lost and Found - What if I come and find it.

As originally intended, we'll have the update ready for next August with lots of new content (it's probably our biggest update so far), including a new helper, power-ups, an items pack, base items and achievements... lots of achievements!

To make the wait shorter, we have thought you'd like to have an original wallpaper of the game, which is starting to lay the groundwork for the story mode's lore. We hope you like it!

See you next month!

(Click on the image to download in higher quality)

notes.title: April update (v0.30)
notes.notes:
Hello players!

In this new free update we bring you new performance optimizations, graphics improvements and the Steam leaderboard integrated inside the game, more info below:

-Updated to Unity 2021 with URP, imrpoving graphics and performance.
-New item outline, which can also be deactivated from the settings of the game.
-TV Screen inside the game where you can check your Lost and Found rank (friends and global). Try to beat your friends scores!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/a273d70d65039bd4d28a47dbe367323802fdc1f6.png

We hope you enjoy it, new updates incoming.

notes.title: 'Ducky pack' update
notes.notes:
The new update 'Ducky pack' is available now with the following content:

-Ducky pack to be unlocked
-Added a new vending machine to unlock more content with your duros
-New and adorable helper to help you finding objects
-Four new achievements
-Four new lost objects for the base pack
-Various bug fixes for the game experience

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: November patch
notes.notes:
The version 0.13 includes a bunch of fixes and improvements to enhance the gameplay, some of them requested by the community:

-Completely reworked the grab system, objects will fall when hitting walls
-Improved the randomization of the objects in the shelvings
-Added the possibility to skip the ending score debriefing
-Added slippery behaviour to the tray, be aware!
-Added an option in game settings to invert the throw / drop action for the grab action in the mouse and controller
-Added new lost item: the slipper
-Improved some models: rubik cubes and cards
-Fixed volumetric and postprocessing setting in second match
-Fixed the animation time of the UI in the first note
-Fixed the UI of the note when pausing the game
-Fixed the animation of the duro coin when pausing the game
-Preventing to throw an object when not already holding it
-Fixed the score animation when pausing the game
-Fixed the bug that was preventing to load the objects and open the door
